title: Original MFC application initialization coordinator

0x546a90.name: TlsAlloc
0x546a90.reason: Physical TLS-index allocation returns a distinct live index or 0xffffffff on exhaustion.

0x546a7c.name: TlsGetValue
0x546a7c.reason: Physical TLS lookup uses both the current thread and allocated index, returning the stored pointer or null.

0x546a84.name: TlsSetValue
0x546a84.reason: Physical TLS publication stores the exact container pointer only on success; a failed return leaves TLS unchanged.

0x546aa4.name: InitializeCriticalSection
0x546aa4.reason: Physical initialization of the exact 24-byte critical-section record, with nonreturning service exceptions.

0x546aac.name: EnterCriticalSection
0x546aac.reason: Physical lock acquisition tracks section identity, owner and recursion.

0x546a9c.name: LeaveCriticalSection
0x546a9c.reason: Physical lock release balances the current owner and section.

0x546b1c.name: GlobalAlloc
0x546b1c.reason: Physical movable global allocation preserves exact flags and separate handle/data identities; failure returns null.

0x546a8c.name: GlobalHandle
0x546a8c.reason: Physical conversion from a global data pointer to its handle also accepts null on initial allocation failure.

0x5469c8.name: GlobalUnlock
0x5469c8.reason: Physical handle unlock decrements its lock count; zero can be a successful final unlock.

0x546a88.name: GlobalReAlloc
0x546a88.reason: Physical movable global reallocation preserves the prefix and preserves old ownership on failure.

0x5469c4.name: GlobalLock
0x5469c4.reason: Physical handle lock returns its data pointer; the cached IAT target remains this same physical import.

0x546aa8.name: LocalAlloc
0x546aa8.reason: Physical local allocation returns live memory or null; flags 0x40 zero bytes, while flags zero do not promise initialized contents.

0x546a80.name: LocalReAlloc
0x546a80.reason: Physical fixed-block reallocation with flags 2 preserves the old prefix and keeps the old allocation alive on failure.

0x546958.name: RaiseException
0x546958.reason: Physical noncontinuable exception boundary: flags 1 must Halt without returning, reached through unchanged original throw helpers; no exception dispatch is fabricated.

0x546abc.name: GetVersion
0x546abc.reason: Physical compatibility-version service used by original singleton-lock initialization; MFC constructors remain original.

0x546b18.name: SetErrorMode
0x546b18.reason: Physical process error mode returns the complete previous DWORD and stores the requested new DWORD; original caches this import target across both calls.

0x5469f4.name: GetModuleFileNameA
0x5469f4.reason: Physical module path lookup writes a bounded NUL-terminated path with a dot for the valid original filename domain; original basename and extension handling remain executed.

0x5469cc.name: lstrcpynA
0x5469cc.reason: Physical bounded ANSI string copy preserves original destination, source and capacity and returns the destination pointer.

0x5469c0.name: GetCurrentThreadId
0x5469c0.reason: Physical logical-thread identity; no native scheduling is inferred.

0x546bfc.name: SetWindowsHookExA
0x546bfc.reason: Physical hook registration observes exact hook kind, original callback identity, module and thread; returns an opaque hook handle or zero without invoking the callback.

0x546b10.name: lstrcpyA
0x546b10.reason: Physical ANSI string copy writes the source including NUL and returns destination; used only when original help-name setup runs.

0x546b14.name: lstrcatA
0x546b14.reason: Physical ANSI string concatenation appends source including NUL and returns destination; used only when original INI-name setup runs.

0x546d28.name: LoadStringA
0x546d28.reason: Physical resource-string service writes within capacity and returns copied length or zero; original resource helper and fallback run unchanged.

0x4a48e0.name: malloc
0x4a48e0.reason: Known CRT allocation boundary for original strdup; allocate exact requested live bytes or return zero. No MFC or name helper becomes a fixture.

RaiseException is a modeled boundary: Physical noncontinuable exception boundary: flags 1 must Halt without returning, reached through unchanged original throw helpers; no exception dispatch is fabricated.
GetVersion is a modeled boundary: Physical compatibility-version service used by original singleton-lock initialization; MFC constructors remain original.
SetErrorMode is a modeled boundary: Physical process error mode returns the complete previous DWORD and stores the requested new DWORD; original caches this import target across both calls.

Owns the complete99-byte initialization coordinator; no coverage exemptions. Every MFC/module/TLS/factory/lock/name/hook helper remains original on the comparison side. No typed exception dispatch or unwind is claimed by a genuine noncontinuable physical RaiseException halt.

Ordinary stdcall4/u32 intentionally matches the current prepared legacy startup adapter boundary. This specification does not grant full-source CPU transport; source-aware TLS/factory composition requires its own admitted contracts and elected native edges.

Explicit unit states may contain an existing module/application and prepopulated application name/help/INI pointers to exercise both owned branches. They are not evidence that real CWinApp/static startup produced that state; connected startup and menu acceptance remain separate.

Case input domain uses valid live module/application spans, stable import identities, original code and sufficient stack/budget. A filename without any dot is outside the valid returning name-setup path because original code dereferences the missing strrchr result.
notes: Boundary independently verified against hash-pinned original in work/packets/mfc_initialization/NOTES.md. All99bytes were observed in fresh original-only execution across cold/warm/second-thread and an explicitly populated application with hook-enabled module state. This is feasibility evidence, not canonical admission or native integration.
